$comment: MCP server registration. Invokes the live-feedback-mcp binary directly — works whether it was installed via `npm install -g @fryanpan/live-feedback-mcp` (post-publish) or via `cd packages/mcp && npm link` (local dev). More reliable than `npx`, which hits the npm registry for `@latest` and fails when the package isn't published yet. Port is auto-discovered from ~/.claude/live-feedback/server.json.
